title: Tradescantia fluminensis ‘Yellow Hill’ - Mini Plug Plant Houseplant - Easy Care
description:
Vigorous trailing perennial with oval, slightly succulent leaves variegated green, yellow, and cream. Occasionally produces small white summer flowers. Ideal for hanging baskets, shelves, or as a cascading accent.


 Key Features:


  Type: Evergreen, trailing houseplant (Conservatory/Greenhouse/Houseplant)
 

  Variety: Tradescantia fluminensis ‘Yellow Hill’ (variegated)
 

  Foliage: Green with yellow/cream stripes
 

  Flowers: Small white (summer, occasional)
 

  Growth: Fast; bushier with tip pinching
 

 Size:


  Ultimate height: 0.1–0.5 m
 

  Ultimate spread: 0.1–0.5 m
 

  Time to size: 2–5 years
 

 Care:


  Light: Bright, indirect or partial shade; avoid harsh direct sun (leaf scorch)
 

  Soil: Peat-free, loam-based potting mix
 

  Water: Moderate in active growth; sparingly in winter
 

  Aspect: East/South/West-facing, sheltered
 

  Hardiness: H1c (indoors in UK; summer outside 5–10°C)
 

  Pruning: Not required; pinch tips to compact. Remove any plain green (reverted) shoots
 

  Propagation: Softwood stem-tip cuttings in spring/summer
 

 Pests/Disease:


  May attract red spider mite, mealybugs, aphids, vine weevil, thrips
 

  Generally disease-free
 

 Safety:


  Potential skin allergen—wear gloves when handling
